systems.system: Automated National Standing Orders (NSO) Mobile Application
systems.platform: mobile application; developed by the Community Health Practitioners Registration Board of Nigeria with the Health Information System Agency
systems.owner: Community Health Practitioners Registration Board of Nigeria (CHPRBN)
systems.tiers: community health practitioners at primary healthcare level; launched 25 October 2025, mandatory for all registered practitioners by 2027

note: A clinical decision-support app for community health practitioners (class community); the document describes no routine reporting or patient record system, so no hmis or emr fact.
